capture_scope: Current F07/F07A/F08 functional rows and F07/F07A/F08 Vector/Clock rows; no source code, media, or reverse data.

direct_slices.scope: Implements one F07.1 256-word transition over one 1,280-word lane history, returning old history[256..512] and the next history formed by dropping the first 256 words and appending the current block. Six lanes and two frames are replayed against U-HISTORY-01 byte files. It does not implement F07.2 transient filtering, F08 transform history, programme ownership, source/callback clocks, or parent reset/fatal/EOF transactions.

Projects caller-supplied six-block short_consumed and other_consumed flags to the selected-profile F07.4 structure-refresh flags. SPX=0 and end-bin=217 are fixed by the selected profile. It does not produce either input flag, implement transient filtering/queues, or own frame state.

Projects caller-supplied prior_short[5] and short_consumed[6][5] into six-by-five dither flags, header syntax presence, and next_previous_short[5] for selector 7/acmod 7/coupling disabled/gate enabled. It does not produce short flags, mutate programme state, serialize a header, or close F07/F12.

One full-band lane only: uses the identity-first selected D05 provider, F09G four-lane mean-square, F07.2 two-stage sample filter and three-stage paired filter, block-end history clear, peak/tier decisions, and separate four-slot short/other queue advancement. It runs a caller-ordered single-lane block stream. It does not implement the other lanes, F07.1 source history join, F07.4/.5 wiring, programme owner, F08, F12 transaction, or whole F07.

The frozen approved package contains selected F07/F07A/F08/F09/F10/F12 model formulas and lifecycle rules; this Wash audit found no missing formula requiring new algorithm research. The unresolved issue is the selected native callback to F07/F07A/F08 owner/source-generation join and parent staged success/fatal/reset/EOF boundary. The analysis fixture seam is TEST_ONLY and does not execute F07 equations, FFT/transform, real ADM, or the production analysis API. A bounded DTHD directory-count discrepancy remains unresolved and is not a global absence claim; DTHD membership in the selected path remains UNBOUND.

Identity-first parsing of the one selected internal-only D05 provider: 33 finite F32 words across P/A/S/O/M/C, exact field/group order, per-group LE hashes, and 132-byte canonical serialization. It performs no filtering, state update, profile fallback, file/environment access, or public distribution.

Implements the shared F08.2 window fold for one caller-supplied 256-word F32 block and independent primary/companion 128-word histories. It returns both folded 256-word banks and both next histories using the selected `math-generated-v1` provider and separate R32 operations. It is branch-independent: the caller owns the long/short flag. It does not implement pre/post rotation, FFT, LFE transform, F07 source/sample production, F09 exponent generation, parent state installation, source clocks, or whole F08 acceptance.

Consumes the paired F08.2 fold for one caller-supplied short FBW block and runs both banks through the two-short pre-rotation, stage-normalized FFT64, and interleaved short post-rotation. It returns primary and companion 256-word spectrum values. The caller must select this branch only when its strict F08 short flag is 1; this leaf does not produce or validate that flag. Long post-rotation, F08 LFE, F07 source/flag production, F09 exponents, frame/parent transaction, source clocks, and whole F08 remain outside this slice.

Consumes one validated F08.2 two-bank fold and a strict signed-I32 short flag of 0 or 1. Flag 0 runs the math-generated long pre-rotation, normalized FFT128, and long post-rotation; flag 1 runs the two-short pre-rotation, normalized FFT64s, and interleaved short post-rotation. It returns primary/companion 256-word spectra without mutating fold histories. It does not produce the short flag, consume F07 source clocks, implement the F08 LFE route, or install a frame/parent state.

Consumes one validated F08.2 two-bank fold, applies the shared math-generated long pre-rotation, performs 16 gathered FFT8 groups, the selected eight-bin low-frequency recurrence, and the seven-bin LFE post-rotation. It returns separate seven-word primary and companion spectra. It owns no transform history, source clock, F09 exponent conversion, frame/AU write, or parent commit.
